name: Willy Sandia
features: tan skin, dark brown hair, brown eyes, Venezuelan features, athletic build, early 30s appearance, slight facial definition, clean-shaven
bio:
A watermelon farmer whose fruit-selling routes taught him to drive fast on country roads. Willy's rural racing instincts serve him well.

The Chavez regime finances his racing adventures, God knows why. It's better not to ask.
